metadata.title: Apple stock falls, chip stocks rebound as oil extends decline: AlphaCheck

content.text:
Good morning. Stocks rebounded on Tuesday, with chip stocks leading tech (XLK) higher ahead of AMD's (AMD) quarterly results after the close.
The rise in tech came despite a decline in Apple (AAPL) shares following the iPhone maker's quarterly results.
Here's a check of the markets in the first few minutes of trading, based on a heat map powered by Yahoo Finance AlphaSpace data.
Oil prices extended declines following a steep sell-off in the prior session.
Brent crude oil futures (BZ=F) tumbled 1% to hover near $103 per barrel, while WTI (CL=F) also fell below $95 per barrel amid hopes of peace talks in the Iran-US conflict.
Here are some other notable stocks that Yahoo Finance readers are viewing this morning: Pfizer (PFE), Palantir (PLTR), and Shopify (SHOP).
